statement: A projectile is launched from the base of a hill at 17 m/s, at 38 degrees above the horizontal. The hillside rises as a straight incline of 12 degrees above the horizontal, in the launch direction. Take g = 9.81 m/s^2. How far from the launch point, measured along the hillside, does the projectile land?
find: Distance along the incline to the landing point.
